nina.sec: Org advisory: rolling out Service Account Ownership & Quarantine workflow. Goal: reduce blast radius from forgotten service accounts and long-lived keys. Starting 2026-06-01 we will mark unclaimed SAs (no owner metadata AND no activity in 180 days) as QUARANTINED. Quarantined SAs will have credentials rotated/disabled after a 10-day grace window unless claimed. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sa-ownership :warning:

infra-bot: org-sa-scan v2 results attached. Found 278 unowned SAs, 64 with keys >120 days, 19 SAs with broad roles (Owner/edit). Top tags: experiments, telemetry, batch-jobs. Full scan: https://redwood.internal/reports/sa-scan-2091123456

josh.platform: timeline? will Dedicated/Private clusters be auto-changed?

nina.sec: timeline: owner-claim window opens 2026-05-01, reminder sweep 2026-05-20, quarantine starts 2026-06-01, final disable/rotate 2026-06-11. For Dedicated we will perform the audits and send notices; we cannot rotate remote on-prem credentials without customer approval. Private customers will get a guidance bundle and a migration assist offer.

andrew.eng: how does claiming work? give me the API/CLI so we can integrate it into our inventory job.

infra-bot: Claim API example (DMs or infra service token required):
```
# claim a service account by app id
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/infra/service-accounts/claim \
  -d '{"app_id":"apps/1234","owner_email":"team+owner@redwood.com","team":"payments"}'
```
Responses: 200 ok, 202 pending verification, 409 conflict if already claimed. CSV export: `https://api.redwood.internal/infra/service-accounts?filter=unclaimed&format=csv`

nina.sec: Migration helpers: we strongly prefer OIDC where possible. Quick snippets: GitHub Actions -> AWS role trust example (minimal):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"},
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
    "Condition":{"StringLike":{"token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub":"repo:yourorg/yourrepo:*"}}
  }]
}
```
GCP rotate/delete keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=sa@example.com && gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=sa@example.com`
Azure app secret rotate: `az ad app credential reset --id <APP_ID> --credential-description "rotated-2026-05"`

leah.sre: our job-runner uses a long-lived SA for backfills. If we quarantine it we'll get failures. Can we flag it as critical?

nina.sec: Yes: file a ticket with label `sa-hold:critical` and include mitigation steps and timeline. Holds are temporary (max 30d) and require an approved remediation plan. Use the template in the runbook. If you expect immediate outages, add `priority: P0` in the ticket.

ops-bot: CSV export queued. Owners DM schedule: top-200 high-risk will get individual DMs between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-05. Full CSV for org admins posted at runbook page when ready.

andrew.eng: will quarantine produce 401/403 errors? what is the expected behavior?

nina.sec: Quarantine sets cred state to "no-issue" for new tokens and revokes any existing refresh tokens tied to the key; behavior depends on platform: some platforms will return 401 immediately, others will produce token churn. Treat quarantined SAs as unavailable for new tokens. We recommend adding a fallback identity or OIDC role for critical paths.

infra-bot: automation note: teams that claim their SAs get a 60-day auto-reminder to rotate keys; unclaimed SAs past 30 days will be suggested for least-privilege review.

nina.sec: Exceptions: small exceptions for short-term supports accepted via `sec-exceptions` ticket with owner, justification, and expiry. Long-lived exceptions (e.g., hardware-constrained appliances) require a GRC approval and compensating controls.

josh.platform: can we get a per-team CSV with owner-email so Platform can bulk-ticket and schedule migration sprints?

ops-bot: per-team CSV export available. Use: `https://api.redwood.internal/infra/service-accounts?group_by=team&format=csv` 1: will DM platform leads with their team list.

nina.sec: Short checklist for teams: 
- Run inventory: call the CSV/export API. 
- Claim SAs you own or add owner metadata by 2026-05-20. 
- Rotate keys older than 90 days or migrate to OIDC. 
- If critical service, file `sa-hold:critical` ticket before 2026-05-27. 
- If you need help, contact sec-automations@redwood.com or ping me (nina.sec) in DM.

leah.sre: thanks, we'll schedule a maintenance window for the backfill job.

andrew.eng: ack, will integrate claim step into our deploy pipeline.

nina.sec: We'll post weekly roll-up status in #eng-security and update the runbook with FAQs. Expect periodic progress pings from infra-bot. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
